name: Givens Rotation
definition: A 2D rotation applied to a 3x3 matrix to zero out or transform specific elements, used here for QR decomposition or SVD-like iterative solving.
summary: A Givens rotation applies a 2D plane rotation to a 3x3 matrix to zero out specific elements, differing from other methods by operating on matrix rows within higher-dimensional space rather than just rotating 2D vectors.
